breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting' as the time integration method. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction entirely. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead incorrectly combined the two methods, stating 'Implement Strang splitting with explicit forward Euler time integration.' This perpetuates the original error.
